title: Compose verify block
description: The optional `verify` block of `.compose/compose.json`. COMP-SETUP-PREFLIGHT-1 owns `preflight` (lib/preflight.js); COMP-VERIFY-FLOW-1 owns `flows` and extends this file with it. Neither key is required: a project may declare either, both, or neither.

preflight.description: Cheap checks run before an expensive verification (the pre-push test gate, `compose build`, `compose preflight`). A failure is reported SETUP-FAIL, never as a product red. The built-in Stratum engine check runs with or without this block; this block only adds project checks and the run lock.

exclusive_runs.description: Hold a per-repository run lock (<main checkout>/.compose/data/verify-run.lock) for the whole gated run, so a second verification run on the same repository refuses SETUP-BUSY instead of racing the first. A holder whose pid is dead is a stale lock and is taken over. Default false.

busy_wait_s.description: Seconds a run waits for a live holder before refusing SETUP-BUSY. Default 0 (refuse at once).

id.description: Unique within the block. Names the check in output and in `failureReason: setup:<id>`. `stratum-engine` is reserved for the built-in check.

command.description: argv array, run with the project root as cwd. Never a shell string.

expect.description: Substring that must appear in the command's stdout or stderr. Without it, the check passes on exit 0.

timeout_s.description: Seconds before the check is killed and fails. Default 10.
